purpose: Compact text action with an optional trailing external-link icon and a ghost hover surface. Use for secondary CTAs in dense layouts (cards, tables, toolbars) where a full `Button` is too heavy. Differs from `navigation/link` by using default body text color and a brand-colored icon.
useWhen: A short secondary CTA ("Learn more") inside a card, feature tile or table where a full `button` is too heavy.
A marketing link that reads in body text color with a brand-colored icon.
avoidWhen: A standalone navigation link in product UI (a domain, a repository, a docs page) → use `link`.
The main action of a section → use `button`.
A link inside a sentence → use a plain anchor with the text-link class.
related: link` — same anatomy (label, trailing icon, ghost hover) in link color, with a `small` size; the default for standalone links.
button` — full action control with kinds, loading and a button element.
bestPractices: Always set `href`; the default `'#'` is a placeholder and the control always renders as an anchor.
Replace the `'Learn more'` default `label` with text that says where the link goes.
Keep the default `pi pi-external-link` icon for off-site targets with `target="_blank"` (`rel="noopener noreferrer"` is added for you); set `showIcon` to false otherwise.
